label: rare weak feature: early copy-phase b input, or steps 3-4 of sequences starting with b/k
explanation: Very sparse (about 0.02% of steps) and weak (max 0.23). Two loose loci: (1) the input token b during the early copy phase (recall_idx 1-3), about 54% of mass, strongest right after <DEL> when the sequence starts b b; (2) original-phase steps t=3-4 in sequences whose first token is b or k, often after x/q/z/l. Never fires at t<3. The disjunction covers about 82% of activation mass, but precision is about 1%: the conditions hold on roughly 100x more steps than the feature fires on, and no tested refinement (prev token, L, first token, repeats) brought precision above about 3%. No coherent selective description was found. Magnitude is fairly flat (median 0.12); the top activations are b inputs right after <DEL> in short b-initial sequences.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=b (+4.60), orig0=b (+4.28), orig0=k (+3.83), phase=2 & out_tok=k (+3.63), prev_tok=q (+3.57), prev_tok=z (+3.41). Lower it: orig_idx=-1 (-2.57), prev3_tok=- (-2.42), prev_tok=b (-2.13), prev_tok=<DEL> (-2.02).
